events.title: A mid-table London derby in the Premier League is the only league action of the day, with 첼시 beating 아스널 1–0 at Stamford Bridge.

미들즈브러 halt their slump in Premier League form but remain in the relegation zone on goal difference, beating 입스위치 타운 1–0 at Portman Road. 셰필드 유나이티드 climb out of the relegation zone with a remarkable 6–0 win over 토트넘 홋스퍼 at Bramall Lane .
Tony Bland dies in hospital after treatment was withdrawn, making him the Hillsborough disaster's 96th victim after nearly four years in a coma.
맨체스터 유나이티드 beat struggling 리버풀 2–1 at Anfield in the Premier League.
With 브리스틀 로버스 having fallen back to the foot of Division One after a brief improvement in results, Malcolm Allison announces his intention to resign as soon as a successor can be appointed.
버밍엄 시티 are taken over by newspaper publisher David Sullivan , who appoints 24-year-old Karren Brady as the first female managing director of a professional football club.
맨체스터 유나이티드 remain top of the Premier League despite a 1–0 defeat to Oldham at Boundary Park, with Neil Adams scoring the only goal of the game.

애스턴 빌라 miss the chance to go back on top of the Premier League, they goalless draw at home to 토트넘 홋스퍼 meaning that 맨체스터 유나이티드 still lead the way on goal difference. 노리치 시티 keep their title challenge on track with a 1–0 away win over 셰필드 유나이티드.
Russell Osman becomes the 브리스틀 시티's new manager. John Ward leaves 요크 시티 to take over at 브리스틀 로버스, and is succeeded at Bootham Crescent by Alan Little .
맨체스터 유나이티드 and 애스턴 빌라 remained locked together on points at the top of the Premier League after a 1–1 draw at Old Trafford.

애스턴 빌라 return to the top of the Premier League with a 2–0 home win over 셰필드 웬즈데이, as the Manchester derby ends in a 1–1 draw at Maine Road. 노리치 시티's 3–0 defeat away to 윔블던 keeps them in third place and is a major step towards survival for their hosts. An entertaining clash at Highbury sees 아스널 beat 사우샘프턴 4–3.
노팅엄 포리스트 miss the chance to climb back out of the relegation zone after Leeds hold them to a 1–1 draw at the City Ground.
Oldham climb out of the bottom three with a 3–2 win over 미들즈브러 at Ayresome Park, which pushes their hosts deeper into relegation trouble.

Bryan 해밀턴 resigns as 위건 애슬레틱 manager in the wake of a defeat to Division Two's basement side 체스터 시티, with 위건 애슬레틱 in serious danger of their first-ever relegation. Dave Philpotts is appointed as caretaker manager for the remainder of the season. Midweek drama in the Premier League sees 셰필드 유나이티드 climb out of the relegation zone with a 3–1 win over Coventry at Highfield Road. 입스위치 타운 are now 16th in the table just two months after being fourth, following a 3–0 defeat to 에버턴 at Goodison Park. Following a 3–0 win over QPR at Loftus Road, 블랙번 로버스 are 15 points off the top with three games in hand over a 노리치 시티 side who have resumed their lead with a 1–0 win over the previous leaders 애스턴 빌라. 맨체스터 유나이티드 miss the chance to regain the lead of the table when 아스널 hold them to a goalless draw at Old Trafford. 노팅엄 포리스트 maintain their survival bid with a 2–1 win at 사우샘프턴.

블랙번 로버스 sign 첼시 defender Graeme Le Saux for £700,000. 노리치 시티 sign 25-year-old 본머스 striker Efan Ekoku for £500,000. 블랙번 로버스 pay 코번트리 시티 £2.5 million for striker Kevin Gallacher , with £1 million-rated Roy Wegerle moving in the opposite direction.
애스턴 빌라's Paul McGrath is voted PFA Players' Player of the Year . The PFA Young Player of the Year award goes to 맨체스터 유나이티드's 라이언 긱스 for the second year running.

England make it four wins from their first five World Cup qualifying matches after defeating Turkey 2–0 away in İzmir . The month ends with 노리치 시티 back on top of the Premier League, though 애스턴 빌라 are just a point behind with a match in hand. 맨체스터 유나이티드 are still close behind, while 블랙번 로버스 have three matches in hand on the leaders. 노팅엄 포리스트 have slipped back into the relegation zone behind 셰필드 유나이티드, while 올덤 애슬레틱 are still in the relegation zone and 미들즈브러 now occupy bottom place. In Division One, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 still lead the way, though 웨스트햄 유나이티드 have cut their lead down to five points. 포츠머스, 스윈던 타운, 밀월 and 레스터 시티 occupy the playoff zone. A dismal run of form for 트랜미어 로버스 has taken them from second to seventh place in just three months, and they are now six points outside the playoff zone. A dismal month for 그림즈비 타운 has seen their promotion challenge virtually ended; in fact, they are actually closer to the relegation zone than to sixth place (albeit only by goal difference). 브리스틀 로버스 are six points away from safety and look certain for relegation, but fellow strugglers Southend and Cambridge end March still optimistic of avoiding the drop. In Division Two, 스토크 시티 are ten points clear of second-placed 포트 베일 and looking all but assured of promotion. Controversial chairman Stan Flashman leaves Division Three leaders 바닛, and as a parting shot sacks and reinstates manager Barry Fry on the same day.
